subTitle: For all our friends and family who have lots of questions, please check out our Q&A first!

faqs.question: Can I bring a date / +1?
faqs.answer: As much as we would love for you to bring a plus-one, at this time, we can’t accommodate additional guests that are not included in the RSVP. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions or concerns.

faqs.question: Are kids welcome?
faqs.answer: Of course you should bring them along if they are included in the RSVP count. If they aren’t, we hope you understand that at this time, we can’t accommodate additional guests that are not included in the RSVP. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions or concerns.

faqs.question: Is the wedding indoors or outdoors?
faqs.answer: While most of the events are planned to be outdoors, we have indoor backup plans in case of inclement weather. The reception will be indoors.

What if I have a dietary restriction?
faqs.answer: We are trying our best to ensure that the menu will cater to universal palettes and preferences. We are also working with our vendors to ensure all labels are clear and meet the standards. If however, you have food allergies or dietary restrictions, do check with our caterer to enjoy you meal stress-free.
